description: This file defines a template-based data structure for handling Type-Length-Value (TLV) encoding, including classes for requests, responses, and buffers, as well as a message exchange class template for communication handling within the WPEFramework namespace.

classes.name: TypeLengthValueType
classes.description: A template struct implementing TLV request, response, and buffer classes for serialization and deserialization.

classes.name: MessageExchangeType
classes.description: A template class managing message exchange, including link management, state handling, and data transmission for a communication channel.

methods.name: Serialize
methods.description: Serializes the TLV request data into a stream buffer.

methods.name: Copy
methods.description: Copies data from a request buffer into a response buffer.

methods.name: Deserialize
methods.description: Deserializes data from a stream buffer into the TLV buffer.

methods.name: Next
methods.description: Advances to the next TLV block in the buffer.

methods.name: Evaluate
methods.description: Evaluates the buffer content for processing.

methods.name: Link
methods.description: Returns a reference to the communication channel handler.

methods.name: SendData
methods.description: Sends data over the communication channel.

methods.name: ReceiveData
methods.description: Receives data from the communication channel.
